[page 1]
   Synthetic Supplier Datasheet - VXS-24 On/Off Valve

     Supplier document      VD-VXS24
    Revision             B
    Date                   05 Feb 2026
     Applicable project tags   XV-101, XV-102, XV-103

 1. Product Family
 Synthetic VXS-24 spring-return, two-position liquid isolation valve with 24 VDC actuator. Project tags XV-101,
 XV-102 and XV-103 use this family.
    Characteristic                      XV-101               XV-102               XV-103

     Project service                      Feed to Tank 1         Tank 1 transfer         Tank 2 drain

    De-energized position                  Closed                 Closed                 Closed

    Nominal demo flow coefficient equivalent  0.0060 m^3/s            0.0045 m^3/s            0.0050 m^3/s

     Full open stroke time                     0.8 s                     0.8 s                     0.8 s

     Full close stroke time                     0.6 s                     0.6 s                     0.6 s

   Command                          24 VDC energized=open  24 VDC energized=open  24 VDC energized=open

 2. Functional Safety Note
 Loss of electrical power removes actuator energy and the spring returns the valve to the closed position. This
 datasheet does not define process sequencing or whether two valves may be open concurrently; that is a
 system-controls decision.
 3. Installation Note
 For the hackathon simulation the dynamic valve stroke is neglected and each valve is treated as an ideal
 Boolean flow switch. The physical stroke times remain useful as equipment properties in the system model.





SYNTHETIC ENGINEERING DATA - HACKATHON USE                                                           Page 1
